fusions.name: Mason Swarm
fusions.desc: Flings 3 barbs of grit at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flint Stinger
fusions.desc: Darts a flint stinger into an enemy for 7 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You hold 4; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Mud Hive
fusions.desc: You raise a hive of packed mud for 15 seconds. Its bees sting the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Daubed Layers
fusions.desc: Every hit you land packs on a layer of mud, building a stack on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
